Booking & Cancellation PolicyPolítica de Reserva y Cancelación
⚠️ Before You BookAntes de Reservar

A scheduling fee is required at the time of booking to secure your appointment. This fee is non-refundable and will be applied toward your total balance. Remaining balance is paid on the day of your appointment. Se requiere un cargo de reserva al momento de agendar para confirmar tu cita. Este cargo no es reembolsable y se aplicará a tu balance total. El saldo restante se paga el día de la cita.

✕ Cancellation PolicyPolítica de Cancelación

Appointments must be cancelled or rescheduled at least 24 hours in advance. No-shows forfeit the scheduling fee and may be required to prepay future appointments in full. Las citas deben cancelarse o reprogramarse con al menos 24 horas de anticipación. La inasistencia sin aviso pierde el cargo de reserva y puede requerir pago completo en futuras citas.

💳 Secure Your AppointmentAsegura tu Cita

A $20 deposit is required to confirm your booking. You'll be redirected to our secure Clover payment page. The deposit is applied to your total balance. Se requiere un depósito de $20 para confirmar tu reserva. Serás redirigido a nuestra página de pago seguro de Clover. El depósito se aplica a tu balance total.
